# C# Changes

Before editing C# source, read the
[C# coding guidelines](../../docs/internal/development/coding-guidelines/csharp.md).
Also read the [clean code guidelines](../../docs/internal/development/coding-guidelines/clean-code.md) for general
C# and .NET practices. Use the [CLI testing strategy](../../docs/internal/development/testing-strategy.md) to determine the appropriate test coverage for your change.
Follow the existing ownership boundaries, nullable and analyzer baseline, and
filesystem abstraction rules. Preserve CSharpier formatting and run the focused
test or build check that covers the change.
